description: iPayX is an FX forensic audit service with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys prefixed ipx_live_ sent in the Authorization Bearer header; webhooks are HMAC-SHA256 signed (inbound only).
gate_detail: Dashboard signup issues a production API key, but pricing lists API plans from $99/mo; free tier is 3 lifetime audits. Unclear whether free users get API keys. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST endpoints for live mid-market rates, FX audits and batch document audits, plus audit.completed webhooks and an MCP server.
mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted MCP server at mcp.ipayx.ai; listed on the official MCP Registry and Glama.
blocker_detail: Production API use depends on a paid plan; free tier is only 3 lifetime audits.

evidence.quote: Access your dashboard and generate your production API key.
One-time forensic FX reports from $297. API plans from $99/mo with up to 50,000 audits per month.
Subscribe to `audit.completed` events to power Zapier triggers, n8n workflows, or your own Slack alerts.
Listed on the official MCP Registry and Glama

uncertainties: Whether the 3-audit free tier includes API keys is not stated.
Pricing sources are partly inconsistent (API plans from $99/mo vs credit packs).
